rules.expectation: Causal/interventional tests requiring absent architecture primitives return structural_absent rather than being simulated by prompting.
Selected behavioral tests may be high while unsupported causal/interventional tests remain structural_absent.
R1 and R2 should improve relative to the same base model when silent recurrent computation is genuinely enabled; unrelated dimensions need not improve.
L3 and I3 are expected to change only if work and control states are independently addressable; ordinary instruction following is not sufficient.
Additional compute may improve generic task accuracy but should not automatically satisfy state-specific intervention tests.
A sham operation should not reproduce the selective causal effect of the corresponding real intervention.
